story: The shape of UK padel approvals changed: the small end rose from 88 approvals to 201.
hold_back: Padel Genie shows where those approvals sit, with venue and planning records behind each one.
why_it_works: It gives away one clean structural shift in the market, then points readers to the local detail that matters.

story: Covered and indoor schemes average 3.18 courts; outdoor schemes average 2.51.
hold_back: Use Padel Genie to see which local approvals are covered or outdoor and how scheme shape varies by place.

story: Change of use reached 29% of new-court submissions, up from 22% in the year to August 2025.
hold_back: Padel Genie lets you inspect the planning records behind those submissions and the places they are happening.

story: Conversions out of industrial, warehouse and retail stock went from 50 applications to 151.

story: The covered share of approvals rose from 31% to 38%.

story: The August report says UK growth is not just more padel; it is smaller schemes, more covered courts and more conversions.

why_it_works: A carousel suits this because the insight is a pattern made of several distinct shifts, not one stat.
